# Image Test Fixtures

| File        | Spec                        |
| ----------- | --------------------------- |
| sample.png  | 800×600 RGB PNG             |
| sample.jpg  | 1024×768 JPEG, quality ~80  |
| sample.webp | Any WebP image              |
| sample.bmp  | Any BMP image               |
| sample.gif  | Animated GIF, 3+ frames     |
| sample.svg  | Simple SVG with shapes/text |
| sample.heic | iPhone photo (HEIC format)  |
| sample.psd  | Photoshop file, 1-2 layers  |
| sample.tiff | Any TIFF image              |
